description: This file defines the InputManagerV16 class, which implements InputManagerCompat to provide input device management functionalities for Android API level 16 (Jelly Bean). It manages input device listeners and delegates input device events.

classes.name: InputManagerV16
classes.description: Implements InputManagerCompat for API level 16, managing input devices and listeners.

classes.name: V16InputDeviceListener
classes.description: Inner class implementing InputManager.InputDeviceListener to forward device events to registered listeners.

methods.name: InputManagerV16
methods.description: Constructor initializing InputManager and listener map.

methods.name: getInputDevice
methods.description: Returns the InputDevice for a given device ID.

methods.name: getInputDeviceIds
methods.description: Returns array of all input device IDs.

methods.name: registerInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Registers a new input device listener with a handler.

methods.name: unregisterInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Unregisters an existing input device listener.

methods.name: onGenericMotionEvent
methods.description: Placeholder for handling generic motion events (unused in V16).

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Placeholder for pause handling (unused in V16).

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Placeholder for resume handling (unused in V16).
